children: Borealis Foods entered into an omnibus amendment and consent agreement and related note amendments with its lender and shareholder creditors, extending several note maturities to Nov. 19, 2029, while leaving its existing $17 million term loan's maturity and core payment terms unchanged. The company also amended the maturity of Saule Algaziyeva's $3 million convertible note to May 1, 2027. The parties mutually terminated a separate debt-to-share conversion agreement; no shares were issued and no termination penalties applied.
Agreement 1: Borealis Foods Resets Debt Terms, Extends Note Maturities and Amends $17 Million Loan
: Omnibus amendment, termination and consent agreement to credit and related loan documents
: Saule Algaziyeva, Oxus Capital, Reza Soltanzadeh, Barthelemy Helg, Z Ventures and Zagros Alpine Capital
: Resolve conversion uncertainty, waive specified defaults and update reporting deadlines
Agreement 2: Borealis Foods Extends $15.3 Million of Barthelemy Helg Notes to 2029
: Extend note maturities and suspend future interest accrual
Agreement 3: Borealis Foods Extends $11.1 Million of Oxus Notes to 2029
: Extend note maturities and suspend future interest accrual
Agreement 4: Borealis Foods Extends $2.4 Million of Z Ventures Notes to 2029
: Extend note maturities and suspend future interest accrual
Agreement 5: Borealis Foods Extends C$450,000 of Zagros Alpine Capital Notes to 2029
: Extend note maturities and suspend future interest accrual
Agreement 6: Borealis Foods Extends Saule Algaziyeva's $3 Million Note to May 2027
: Extend the note maturity and waive a maturity-related default
Agreement 7: Borealis Foods Ends Debt-to-Share Conversion Agreement Without Penalties
: Conversion Agreement providing for automatic conversion of certain indebtedness into common shares
: Oxus Capital, Reza Soltanzadeh, Barthelemy Helg, Z Ventures, Zagros Alpine Capital and other parties
: The specified equity financing was not completed by the deadline
